items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That band – the trumpet section was Sweets Edison, Snooky Young, Cat Anderson, Johnny – the guy that . . . – oh, Conte Candoli, and Johnny . . . [INTERVIEWER] Johnny Coles?

ctx.x: So you’re conductor, not drummer? You didn’t do both duties?

Oh yeah. I let Don do the conducting. I let Don do the tempos. I started the tempos off. He was good with it. He knew the tempos too. Then later on, when Don passed away, I took over as – leading from the drums, because Pearl’s television show – in 1972 she did 15 shows. That band – the trumpet section was Sweets Edison, Snooky Young, Cat Anderson, Johnny – the guy that . . . – oh, Conte Candoli, and Johnny . . .
